____ Hello Friend,

I invite you to meet the new year by studying God's Word through the brand-new 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_.

This 532-page leather-bound book is available now with our thanks for your generous matching challenge gift to support _Pathway to Victory_.

With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

One of the ways we can stay close to the Lord is by reading His Word and maintaining a devotional time of prayer and reflection on the Scriptures.
---
| | Our annual devotional is one of the most popular resources we offer, and it makes a perfect Christmas gift. With a forest-green leather cover and inlaid wood brown and gold foil, this beautiful devotional can be used daily, providing spiritual nourishment and biblical guidance. It contains 260 devotions (Monday through Friday for all 52 weeks) written to encourage, inspire, convict, comfort, and teach you biblical truth to face the new year with spiritual readiness.
---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z9vsts5iid7c4ta93f7sq0h8c0llhuokv3nndqfo_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c3i6cor0clh2bs)
---
| | We're offering the devotional as a thank-you gift to those who donate to _Pathway to Victory_ today.

Here's an outline of what we'll be studying together this year:

-- From January to February, we'll begin the year with straight talk from the Savior.
-- From March through May, we'll take a fresh look at the Holy Spirit.
-- In the summer, we'll gain wisdom from Solomon's reflections in Ecclesiastes.
-- And in the fall and winter, we'll explore 1 Corinthians together.

And the best part is that your gift of any size will be doubled in its impact thanks to the _Proclaim the Gospel_ $500,000 Matching Challenge running until December 31.

To support the work God is doing through _Pathway to Victory_ , and to receive your beautiful copy of the devotional, you can use this link: [https://ptv.org/donate/2024-pathway-to-victory-daily-devotional/](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zrucrv32ga7nn9ahqjfe06pnt39erqassknkcm00_rp22sh2s8i6eo34c3i6cor0clh2bs).

With a donation of $300, we will send you 10 copies of the 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_ , a great Christmas gift for anyone!

I have no doubt that 2024 will present many challenges--globally, politically, economically, and personally--but God remains in control of all things, and our job is simply to stay close to His leading. I pray that this devotional will help you do just that.

I'm very thankful for your friendship with _Pathway to Victory_.

God bless you,
Dr. Robert Jeffress

clean_body: | | | | | | | | | Dear Peter, This campaign is by Alaskans and for Alaskans, not special interests or corporations. I want to make sure that my priorities reflect yours, Peter. Just as they have with my work in the Dunleavy administration. We can all agree that Bidenomics is NOT working for Alaskans and all Americans. Taxpayers are spending an extra $11,000/yr just to maintain the same standard of living. That's ridiculous and I pledge to end this assault on our families. My priorities when I get to Congress will also be to fight for American energy independence, support our allies in Israel, support law enforcement, and get our country on the right track for future generations. My husband, children, and grandchildren drive my continued dedication to public service and success for our state and country. Are you with me? Warm regards, Nancy Dahlstrom Candidate for Congress, Alaska At-Large | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | No longer want to receive these emails? .

# [Sign your name: Tell Congress to pass the Fight Book Bans Act](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td9fa5f53-e3ca-4fc1-bbba-240a55998b02/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | Democratic Rep. Maxwell Frost just introduced a new bill in Congress to fight back against book bans. The [**Fight Book Bans Act**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9d621b01-efb3-4a79-8b38-46120e707c99/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) "takes a stand against censorship by giving school districts the funding that they need to oppose these challenges." Rep. Frost's home state of Florida had the most book bans in the country last year, comprising 40 percent of book bans across the nation. Republicans in Florida and other states are waging war on our education system by attempting to ban books that discuss women's issues, race, LGBTQ issues, and more. They're trying to whitewash and even erase key parts of history and keep kids from learning about important issues! This is a crisis for our education system. We need Congress to pass the Fight Book Bans Act so we can fight censorship and provide kids with books about important topics from inclusive voices and perspectives. [**Add your name: Tell Congress to pass the Fight Book Bans Act >>**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te6b98772-0b59-4429-bbf6-2f82b64c536a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

____ Hello Friend,

I invite you to meet the new year by studying God's Word through the brand-new 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_.

This 532-page leather-bound book is available now with our thanks for your generous matching challenge gift to support _Pathway to Victory_.

With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

One of the ways we can stay close to the Lord is by reading His Word and maintaining a devotional time of prayer and reflection on the Scriptures.

This 532-page leather-bound book is available now with our thanks for your generous matching challenge gift to support Pathway to Victory. With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever. One of the ways we can stay close to the Lord is by reading His Word and maintaining a devotional time of prayer and reflection on the Scriptures. | | Our annual devotional is one of the most popular resources we offer, and it makes a perfect Christmas gift. With a forest-green leather cover and inlaid wood brown and gold foil, this beautiful devotional can be used daily, providing spiritual nourishment and biblical guidance. It contains 260 devotions (Monday through Friday for all 52 weeks) written to encourage, inspire, convict, comfort, and teach you biblical truth to face the new year with spiritual readiness. | | | We're offering the devotional as a thank-you gift to those who donate to Pathway to Victory today. Here's an outline of what we'll be studying together this year: -- From January to February, we'll begin the year with straight talk from the Savior. -- From March through May, we'll take a fresh look at the Holy Spirit. -- In the summer, we'll gain wisdom from Solomon's reflections in Ecclesiastes. -- And in the fall and winter, we'll explore 1 Corinthians together. And the best part is that your gift of any size will be doubled in its impact thanks to the Proclaim the Gospel $500,000 Matching Challenge running until December 31. To support the work God is doing through Pathway to Victory , and to receive your beautiful copy of the devotional, you can use this link: . With a donation of $300, we will send you 10 copies of the 2024 Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional , a great Christmas gift for anyone! I have no doubt that 2024 will present many challenges--globally, politically, economically, and personally--but God remains in control of all things, and our job is simply to stay close to His leading. I pray that this devotional will help you do just that. I'm very thankful for your friendship with Pathway to Victory. God bless you, Dr. Robert Jeffress Conservatives Give 625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314 |

Ilhan's counting on all of us to make this movement successful, and we wouldn't have it any other way.

Friends -
At the end of this email, I'm going to ask you **[to make your first contribution — of $3 or anything you can — to stand with our people-powered re-election campaign for Congress,**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-dec23.Lgr9Ln&refcode=em231205-1-t2&t=2&akid=777%2E791427%2EYTQVLr) but before I do, I hope you'll give me a minute of your time to explain why your support is so important.
Here's the deal:
December is an important month for political campaigns across the country, but that's especially true for ones like ours, that are powered by lots and lots of small-dollar, grassroots contributions, chipped in by people giving what they can.
That's because at the end of the month, we're facing an official FEC fundraising deadline — the final one before 2024, when this race will truly begin to heat up.
We've written to you about these deadlines before, but I mean it when I say this is a big one.
In the days after this deadline passes, our team is _legally required_ to publicly report our fundraising numbers for the year.
That means how much we've raised, but more importantly, how many individual contributions we've received. Good or bad, no matter what, for all to see.
I can guarantee you that everyone — from AIPAC and the right-wing super PACs to our primary challengers and the media — will be among the very first looking through the receipts.
They're going to use these public reports to see if our movement is showing _any_ signs of weakness, or if we have the grassroots strength to take them on and fight back as we've always done.
The only way we're funding this campaign is together, and we need to report the strongest numbers we possibly can to show there is nothing that will slow this movement down.
That's why your support — along with the support of countless progressives standing in solidarity all across the country — is so important. Especially today.

# Just What I Was Warning Of: Maryland Hires 'AI' Czar from Big Data With _No Rules_.
---
|
---
|
---
| [ ](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=6b567239df&e=5bb5efcda7)
---
|
####
Friend,
Today, in Washington County's newspaper [Herald-Mail Media, a lead article announced that Maryland has hired an AI Advisor](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=0c05edd68b&e=5bb5efcda7) from "META (Facebook)." What we need in Congress is strong leadership to protect us through the rule of law.

**_Make no mistake, our system of government requires only elected members of the Legislature to write law which must be passed under due process._**

Yet, the new AI "Senior Advisor" in Maryland from META (Facebook) and also formerly AMAZON, answering to his supervisor Director Savage, the DOD ["V@x Digital Chief"](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=5b116e14d8&e=5bb5efcda7) I warned you about last January, is listed on the governor's website as hired to write "ethical guidelines," coordinate with "business" and the federal state as to all uses of "generative artificial intelligence."

Regardless of your political persuasion, this is concerning as even Democrat Senator Katy Hester has pointed out recently in Maryland's oversight hearing where she called for the Legislature to pass law to protect us.

But with BIG TECH and BIG DATA writing the rules, it is more likely that Maryland will simply rubber stamp whatever these unelected bureaucrats decide is worthy to be used on us. Such as [my recent article](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=335e1a9cd3&e=5bb5efcda7) on Maryland's plan to implement Biden's AI tracking and taxing of our vehicle and travel.

This is not "right wing propaganda" or "alarmist" rhetoric. _These are the facts straight from their own testimony_. We need legal protections to keep us all safe.

body:
With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

____ Hello Friend,

I invite you to meet the new year by studying God's Word through the brand-new 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_.

This 532-page leather-bound book is available now with our thanks for your generous matching challenge gift to support _Pathway to Victory_.

With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

One of the ways we can stay close to the Lord is by reading His Word and maintaining a devotional time of prayer and reflection on the Scriptures.
---
| | Our annual devotional is one of the most popular resources we offer, and it makes a perfect Christmas gift. With a forest-green leather cover and inlaid wood brown and gold foil, this beautiful devotional can be used daily, providing spiritual nourishment and biblical guidance. It contains 260 devotions (Monday through Friday for all 52 weeks) written to encourage, inspire, convict, comfort, and teach you biblical truth to face the new year with spiritual readiness.
---
| [](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=888b7040425e4b3382ccfeb6a30022c9&_e=l9FENzTdUGeoSBJIJ0l6JvVMk8G81jcV8HmR_RVB6kNneVL7XpFBlUE4mDR-5VM_EHEGVmLHrSvkQgNtn-xEvSTBE6rsyFDM3UBWSLWEPwzTD3uOw-wUjto5YhTqo58te7hEetSIbPLjAUiw1osMhh_pkpxzJ9Vp7Dkl2HKUsc1OAz1UNlto4-JV0tQDl-qayCLrypIprc_CFR8AuPB8-N9R9IqMeX_UdLJATP_Bu29pT6DkWpmYx-2lEq-ZDQxDhTfNHhMx_dZpVGnn7ARiuS21kUcy1up3HZJfOYQGczj1Ar8RDIPrkL4W-lnbTqkkh45vnJAqvx6vBAIHA9xTw_qk56SZQ_nqd-qIp_2NzQhAsB7HjtdONF1q9GQOf--g)
---
| | We're offering the devotional as a thank-you gift to those who donate to _Pathway to Victory_ today.

Here's an outline of what we'll be studying together this year:

-- From January to February, we'll begin the year with straight talk from the Savior.
-- From March through May, we'll take a fresh look at the Holy Spirit.
-- In the summer, we'll gain wisdom from Solomon's reflections in Ecclesiastes.
-- And in the fall and winter, we'll explore 1 Corinthians together.

And the best part is that your gift of any size will be doubled in its impact thanks to the _Proclaim the Gospel_ $500,000 Matching Challenge running until December 31.

To support the work God is doing through _Pathway to Victory_ , and to receive your beautiful copy of the devotional, you can use this link: [https://ptv.org/donate/2024-pathway-to-victory-daily-devotional/](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=888b7040425e4b3382ccfeb6a30022c9&_e=l9FENzTdUGeoSBJIJ0l6JvVMk8G81jcV8HmR_RVB6kNneVL7XpFBlUE4mDR-5VM_EHEGVmLHrSvkQgNtn-xEvSTBE6rsyFDM3UBWSLWEPwzTD3uOw-wUjto5YhTqo58te7hEetSIbPLjAUiw1osMhh_pkpxzJ9Vp7Dkl2HKUsc1OAz1UNlto4-JV0tQDl-qayCLrypIprc_CFR8AuPB8-COlahkE88a-4z_wBQswe0XgcE_4auQsTLFCHKexjSHB8I3pr9JpnjDjCixgJRfV99oDGqR5A9kx77uda4VVBwUJdjzmb_zCcdIbAy9KOX8vxSRqJKQPs9dgVRWRBjHbiz1n3ROL7PSjjEC_aQHgXy0gGseGKKNTB0itS-5Gldfo).

With a donation of $300, we will send you 10 copies of the 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_ , a great Christmas gift for anyone!

I have no doubt that 2024 will present many challenges--globally, politically, economically, and personally--but God remains in control of all things, and our job is simply to stay close to His leading. I pray that this devotional will help you do just that.

I'm very thankful for your friendship with _Pathway to Victory_.

God bless you,
Dr. Robert Jeffress

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/TOP.png]
The Affordable Care Act has provided coverage to millions of Americans and has saved them from the clutches of a corrupt for-profit healthcare system. Yet, my opponent, Rep. Jack Bergman thinks it's as good as trash.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/abaca [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/abaca]
Bergman has been a staunch opponent of expanding coverage and continues to be anti-healthcare. Over a million Michiganders will lose their coverage if the ACA is repealed.
CONTRIBUTE $5 TO HEALTHCARE REFORM [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/abaca]
Friend,
When questioned about fixing alleged issues with the ACA, my opponent stated he intends to repeal Obamacare, but has no plans to replace it with system that works. Understandably, it was met with boos in 2017, and his position is even less popular today.
Nearly 70% of Americans support universal healthcare.
Jack Bergman wants a completely privatized healthcare system; a system that works better for shareholders than it does patients.
Under our privatized system, medical costs in the US are more than twice as much as any other country, yet we don't have better health outcomes or longer lives.
One third of hospitals, 70% of nursing homes, and half of assisted living facilities are for-profit.
Healthcare reform — expanding Medicare — will boost our economy, improve care, and reduce costs. It would save taxpayers $500 billion a year and countless lives. When 25% of our federal budget is healthcare related, what are we waiting for?
A donation from you today, whether $5, $50, or $500 can make a big difference in our effort to defeat Bergman and create a national non-profit health insurance program that fully covers all medical costs for every American
Join me in the fight for universal healthcare. Help me be the 'doctor in the House' to get it done.
Grateful for your support,
Dr. Bob
Bob Lorinser
Candidate for US Congress
Northern Michigan / Upper Peninsula
Democrat, MI01

Peter - when my husband was recently elected Speaker of the House, our world was flipped upside down.

Fellow American - when my husband was recently elected Speaker of the House, our world was flipped upside down.

But I believe to my core that God has a plan for every single one of our lives, and I know that my husband Mike was chosen for a reason. Mike and I have been married for 24 years, and during that time I have seen his desire for servant leadership, his patriotism for this country, and his love for all people.

**It is the honor of a lifetime to call Mike my husband, and I feel so proud and grateful to watch him serve our country as Speaker of the House.**

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
Alexandria’s community sent her to Congress on purpose to disrupt and challenge a lot of what’s wrong in D.C.
But during her first term, many people in her own party said her election was a fluke, a mistake, and that there was “nothing to worry about.” Many believed that Alexandria would be a one-term Congresswoman.
One colleague in Congress said they were “shocked” to see how hostile her own party was towards Alexandria from the moment she arrived — and she still faces hostility to this day
It was clear from the beginning that the party never wanted Alexandria there. It’s why a Moderate Democrat mounted a $3 million primary challenge, and why Republicans spent over $10 million trying to unseat her in 2020.
Now Alexandria already has at least one MAGA Republican opponent next year. So we need to be ready to fight back against their posters, mailers, commercials, and whatever else they’ll throw at us this year and next.

The combination of technology, globalization and tax policy have combined to increase compensation and wealth for people at the top. CEOs and celebrities benefit while blue collar workers suffer from depressed wages.
My name is Carolyn Rush, and I am a Democratic mother of five who has spent over 3 decades working as an engineer. I’m running to represent New Jersey’s Second Congressional District in the United States House of Representatives.
My district is currently represented by a party-changing Republican who believes tax cuts for the wealthy are a good economic strategy. He has sworn allegiance to Donald Trump over the needs of the people he represents and our country overall. He’s fine with the ultra-wealthy getting richer while the working class get left behind - but I’m not!

Peter,

You might not know me very well – _probably because I have been heads down working for the past seven years in Congress._

So, in my own words, I want to give you a chance to hear what I stand for.

**To my core, I believe the most important things are God, family, and country.**

**_I believe that God is not done with America yet._**

**I believe we need to unite as a party and unite as a nation. The hour is late, and the crisis is great – but I am bullish about the future of America.**

I believe in the law – I’m a constitutional law attorney and I respect the law.

**I believe America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of the world – _but our days as the beacon of freedom for the world are numbered if we let the far-left force their anti-American agenda on the rest of us._**

[**Last November, the American people put their faith in House Republicans and gave us a majority. We’ve been charged with holding Democrats accountable for their failure to get our country out of the malaise of their own making. To deliver on the promises we made, we need you on our team TODAY.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=152ae378274d4979866e8de5cb3d12f1&_e=YwO5rDOMRfnA6kQz6HoZ2CVWDEPystE-SGcr6yIrl9tHvH4tyF5Q7pzgmAOeufM5OIvyv97jCQby9bfG44KKen4oW_PosNjdhhWewmnnzA-hOcui1q-Snac9ClZuUh7Q7sMkpl9_HaD7hkT6cjgBHTjpMyvss6SUY7kwHHJOblEVcQ8o0YDVeKvPhfrtvMcthZ1aPctZdHx1_G5AMU7A8v5m9aWQwA6T8Dh-vk_RFn7UqZvq5S_IpuPtyoFr1xHa-FHmG69GDo9FhBJWCxjM4onm_UU5_GBUfK1ILcZt0qXRB51kAFaiVWfwdkHoQJUHMxtvWFlcn2hk4Y_x8Gy-Igc6WTTtYx83pSRRtW3aex5t_lHMm-N3UcetiNat-rQfyQxr0K9I2keyghQjM-Q1iTg3Ykjy6FnwRRQN9SDFIGY%3D)

[** STAND WITH SPEAKER MIKE > **](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=152ae378274d4979866e8de5cb3d12f1&_e=YwO5rDOMRfnA6kQz6HoZ2CVWDEPystE-SGcr6yIrl9tHvH4tyF5Q7pzgmAOeufM5OIvyv97jCQby9bfG44KKen4oW_PosNjdhhWewmnnzA-hOcui1q-Snac9ClZuUh7Q7sMkpl9_HaD7hkT6cjgBHTjpMyvss6SUY7kwHHJOblEVcQ8o0YDVeKvPhfrtvMcthZ1aPctZdHx1_G5AMU7A8v5m9aWQwA6T8Dh-vk_RFn7UqZvq5S_IpuPtyoFr1xHa-FHmG69GDo9FhBJWCxjM4u71FuoB7w-cLsj47DbQ1oLmn3UGvByDFvFBZczNm9Z70TWhfipzK936mfMlB2HYBowudMvv3CSGGPj1n1MMVtt2brewREPYc7KfahaAuXZYUpdt5zodc6KMfRwY2ZFNBsDp7xwd6yi7zBOuBN8Gtv0%3D)

Peter, I know it takes time to build trust; you’re getting to know me and I’m navigating this new role – but we must act – and quickly. We need a full course correction,**otherwise, I’m not sure what version of America we’ll hand down to the next generation.**

body:
Democrats in Central Washington Roar!
| | **Can't see this message?_[View in a browser](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/47OmxgruZ/c?w=SES2fnOeLdXckkQjJU3v3iEmC0dNhlwAJYgfcZzN_Ss.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucnVyYWxhbWVyaWNhbnN1bml0ZWQub3JnL3NvLzQ3T214Z3J1Wj9sYW5ndWFnZVRhZz1lbiIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9)_**
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| | Occasionally our newsletter focuses on our accomplishments and a blatant request for money. All other newsletters focus on events and information. Stick with us.
---
| | [](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/47OmxgruZ/c?w=xW-hWxbZqt88OIOSMrs1joj8TFkeFQKnJ5uEQxsHIOg.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL3JhdV95ZWFyX2VuZF8yMDIzIiwiciI6IjlmOGNmYWEyLTdiYTItNDNiMy04YjRmLWYyZGQ1MjBlZjQ1YiIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9)
---
| | |
---
| | Celebrating One Million Delivered!
---
| | In the past four weeks, Rural Americans United’s pro-Democratic radio spots have been heard one million times by listeners throughout Central Washington! For the very first time, thousands of people have been exposed to core Democratic goals with the power to vastly improve the lives of working class people on the eastside of the Cascades. In all, RAU has committed to a $350,000, 14-month media blitz, which will blanket the 4th District with 20,000 separate radio spots. In English and Spanish, the ads are believed to be the largest public awareness campaign ever launched in the state.
---
| |
---
| | The first month of RAU’s remarkable advertising campaign was met with a wave of support pouring in from across the state, thanking us for giving them hope and representation in communities that are often subjected to intimidation and even violence against those that hold democratic values. When I write us, I mean all of us that contribute, write notes of encouragement, support candidates, run for office and so many other things. Winning is never a singular accomplishment, it takes all of us. To keep these inspiring pro-Democratic broadcast messages rolling, Rural Americans United needs your financial support. Please help us celebrate the holiday season and the New Year with great joy, knowing the lives of so many have been touched with good and sensible values. We must raise $43,000 dollars before the end of the year to keep the momentum up. [Click here](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/47OmxgruZ/c?w=a6vKaAugzWuCSl2wp7S5crYqmikVoBM8mjIU8wJNMhE.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL3JhdV95ZWFyX2VuZF8yMDIzIiwiciI6IjE4MDMxNGJiLWMwNzItNDRhYS1iYjBkLThlZWEwYTQ0NjMwZiIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9) to help RAU meet this year's funding goal.
---
| | [](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/47OmxgruZ/c?w=ufyagXFxnw4Cv05jUnLR3clsookMJkVegIQ02kt_pJU.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL3JhdV95ZWFyX2VuZF8yMDIzIiwiciI6IjVjYTQyZDI1LWI0ZmYtNGJlYy1iMWZlLTUxODVjM2Y4OTBiOCIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9)
---
| | |
---
| | Local Media GainsInterest in Democrats
---
| | We are making Central Washington Democrats newsworthy again! For thirty years or more Democrats have had little to no relationship with TV, radio and newspapers. Without solid Democratic political infrastructure, journalists seeking quotes from a Democrat are unsure where to turn. There is a continuous onslaught of Republican noise in Central Washington; but without Democratic media infrastructure, the business of creating responses and structuring information in a form that radio, TV and print journalists can use just doesn’t happen. Without sources for the Democratic side of stories, local media are left with only Republican party rhetoric while the Democratic voice diminishes.
---
| | [](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/47OmxgruZ/c?w=oW85elmNwm0ZZsEby254IQIfvImbBn7BnKvfUymBwFo.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL25ld3NsZXR0ZXItMTEuMDguMjMiLCJyIjoiNzI5YWFkZTQtM2ZhNi00NTY4LWEzNGEtNTliNjVmOGY4MDJkIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0)
---
| | Starting two years ago, RAU began rebuilding these important relationships with the media to get our story out there. During the last election cycle we started to see the fruits of our efforts. We were able to get pro-Democratic articles published in papers up and down Central Washington as well as in Seattle and Spokane. Additionally, we placed articles calling out the heinous methods that local Republican parties are using to subvert the political process, undermine election integrity and unfairly sway voting to their benefit. As a result of our work, Central Washington media outlets are showing a new interest in Democrat content. We will continue to build on that success, working to increase the visibility and voice of rural Americans. Your generous support is making all the difference! A sample of publications are below.
---
| |
* Tri City Herald - Newhouse votes in line with GOP for House speaker. Without sources for the Democratic side of stories, local media are left with only Republican party rhetoric while the Democratic voice diminishes. | | | | Starting two years ago, RAU began rebuilding these important relationships with the media to get our story out there. We were able to get pro-Democratic articles published in papers up and down Central Washington as well as in Seattle and Spokane. Additionally, we placed articles calling out the heinous methods that local Republican parties are using to subvert the political process, undermine election integrity and unfairly sway voting to their benefit. body:
Rioters put congressmen in jeopardy and punched a few federal police officers, no big deal...| | | [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=f897f2aedca94056bc0ddc4e22613299&_e=R563cCEck1-gX44qq7ZD5gto9lrZg2fFsvzV9Ehg-aZ0B5oB216i1R_N5_LMGaem5y3KBpV6tpl86EzuykNL8mxtluvgicgyWExcakdIJy96101A7dzWs1b0chR1UBIJnzRZqdYYOI18BIQYeGvthMwVgiGCcSGr-BdqqfJ5BhxtWKbAyUo-SUQXv5dMw_eZic-J8RgcH_cUDkRmzT37TvdVUlnfBO2oGw6BbZYnp0M0kmMQSsD1S_CMWP5Oq5mTIZC2zPLadrFlY5D_ib5tnD7KWzd2XKLW10BrMuhirxCcIm5hPMmL6zDwT6lj3QixrEVLozn8wn_vqQM_RtplELE36VS00sYYXGqzgCuf2kCwDVbzeMG05AzkJCQHZR4v)
---
Peter, **Did you know that over 200 armed pro-Palestinian protestors mobbed the DNC HQ recently, trapping members of Congress inside & injuring 6 Capitol Police officers?**
---
[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=f897f2aedca94056bc0ddc4e22613299&_e=R563cCEck1-gX44qq7ZD5gto9lrZg2fFsvzV9Ehg-aZ0B5oB216i1R_N5_LMGaem5y3KBpV6tpl86EzuykNL8mxtluvgicgyWExcakdIJy96101A7dzWs1b0chR1UBIJnzRZqdYYOI18BIQYeGvthMwVgiGCcSGr-BdqqfJ5BhxtWKbAyUo-SUQXv5dMw_eZic-J8RgcH_cUDkRmzT37TvdVUlnfBO2oGw6BbZYnp0M7q64EieMXdhzWHGwacQxij-unR-K5CajgFrTLft7tOlD_o1ps4d19qkWgzPQW15SdnGR7zOqcey2WJMa2FaqjQigw6p2Guqmc5mIOHET5ltGc2GfRzb4qrxyQn_aXuxjyP6Z1y56m0AkkEDMYIDg-)
---
Soon after, the DOJ spoke out on a federal prosecution of a group of protestors—but it WASN’T the rioters.

Nope! They were spiking the football on their conviction of a 75-year-old grandma & 9 other pro-lifers who conducted a peaceful sit-in at an abortion clinic.
**That praying grandma is looking at a sentence of up to 11 years...[ and the protestors who punched federal police officers and put members of Congress in jeopardy have yet to get even a harsh word from the DOJ. ](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=f897f2aedca94056bc0ddc4e22613299&_e=R563cCEck1-gX44qq7ZD5gto9lrZg2fFsvzV9Ehg-aZ0B5oB216i1R_N5_LMGaem5y3KBpV6tpl86EzuykNL8mxtluvgicgyWExcakdIJy96101A7dzWs1b0chR1UBIJnzRZqdYYOI18BIQYeGvthMwVgiGCcSGr-BdqqfJ5BhxtWKbAyUo-SUQXv5dMw_eZic-J8RgcH_cUDkRmzT37TvdVUlnfBO2oGw6BbZYnp0Ng17tP-y40AFdzXrA-6dkqokO2i6eQ-3JjGvCCqKj92aziwfUf6xT9clYAujFzfUDksOYmWytdOYhVhUBNZOVytKNQX77YAPPQ3MCztY0jqlUtWGdNqCpEs8qn3Oo_gscBmbht9zKRHugOf-mFcFlP)** _Are you sick to your stomach yet, Peter?_
I suppose we shouldn’t be surprised when we’ve already seen pro-life crisis pregnancy centers firebombed and cities looted, while law enforcement barely bats an eye.

But it's not enough to call out the double standards of politicized law enforcement agencies.

**We have to go on offense. It's time to fight the root problem: the leftist activists who have infiltrated our judicial system.**

_**[Fair Courts America exists to put a stop to all that.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=f897f2aedca94056bc0ddc4e22613299&_e=R563cCEck1-gX44qq7ZD5gto9lrZg2fFsvzV9Ehg-aZ0B5oB216i1R_N5_LMGaem5y3KBpV6tpl86EzuykNL8mxtluvgicgyWExcakdIJy96101A7dzWs1b0chR1UBIJnzRZqdYYOI18BIQYeGvthMwVgiGCcSGr-BdqqfJ5BhxtWKbAyUo-SUQXv5dMw_eZic-J8RgcH_cUDkRmzT37TvdVUlnfBO2oGw6BbZYnp0NfCBKTpuTTT96qM1d_xFnjVDbnlQ3rp-Ti-fkNkherGuDYXIHCynzA52qGDBKT4PGM9UrG2t6YEoM1sMaR7iDqv8cg_6HOzASIsNSQ8jDlsPgTq6jbB_NpCI3RDOh5mfolDsqTPEtrF0OmUC994VwV)**_

We say NO to anyone who would endanger equal justice under the law.

You can’t pick and choose which laws to enforce. And you can’t use your judicial powers to intimidate your political enemies.

If we lose the rule of law in our country... we lose our republic. It’s as simple as that.

**As the left gets bolder in their judicial overreach, we need more allies like you who will fight back. Will you join us to defend equal justice under the law, before it’s too late?**

The American bumblebee population has plummeted by 89% in the last two decades, **nearly vanishing from eight states already.** Meanwhile, bee-killing pesticides -- neonics -- have made U.S. agriculture nearly 48 times more toxic to insects in the past three decades.
Neonics hurt people, too. _**They have been linked to health impacts like birth defects of the heart and brain, hormone disruption, and autism.**_
Bees that encounter neonics can face horrible fates. The pesticides can _**kill bees on contact.**_ But even if they survive, the toxic chemicals attack bees’ nerve cells and can harm their cognition, flight ability, and even reproduction.
Now, the EPA could approve these bee-killing neonics for another 15 years and subject even more bees to this fate.
Why is the EPA dragging its feet on banning neonics? Perhaps because pesticide giants like Bayer-Monsanto continue to funnel big money into disinformation efforts -- all to deny and distract from the role that their products play in bee deaths.
But together, we can counter the disinformation, speak louder than the pesticide industry, and push for stronger pollinator protections.
**Stop companies like Bayer-Monsanto from harming pollinators and destroying our planet: Donate $27 before the clock strikes midnight!**

Bees are an essential part of our ecosystem and way of life. Without bees and other pollinators, we’d have far fewer fruits, veggies, and nuts -- **almonds wouldn’t even exist at all.** And other crops like coffee and cotton could become rare or more expensive if bees continue to decline.
If we don’t act now to ban bee-killing pesticides, today’s children could be some of the last people to share the planet with many species of wild bees.

At the same time, we’re researching and shining a light on the pesticide industry’s disinformation tactics to make sure decision-makers know the truth about the toxic way we produce food. But it’s an uphill battle -- one we can’t win without you.

Hi friend – My name is Chris, and I’m Andrea’s husband.

While Andrea is back, hard at work, in DC, I wanted to reach out to ask for your help on a birthday surprise I’m planning for her! Let me explain:
**[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/74641436/442183864/-2066741384?refcode=em_fr_2023.12.05_b1_ts_all-nd&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZWFkYWI4Yi1iNzkzLWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgyMjNmMzYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gDtnGItxUYr2BnZ2CAs-pEYQf0iAOJqmSJh6mMhrHZ0=)** _Here’s one of my favorite family pictures with Andrea and our daughter, Amelia._
I’ve known Andrea for over 30 wonderful years and we’ve been married for the last 24.

From the moment I met her, I knew that she would dedicate her life to working to create a stronger, more prosperous future for our community and country. That became even more apparent when our daughter, Amelia, was born. I have seen her fight tirelessly to make the world a better place for her and all of us.

**You can take it from me: There is no one who fights harder for our community than Andrea.**_(Trust me, I see all the early mornings, late nights, and weekend work up close!)_

Friend,

The U.S. Constitution leaves wealth taxation to voters, not the courts. But in Moore v. United States, the Supreme Court threatens to change that.

The Court is hearing arguments right now from lawyers for the super-rich who want to stop Congress from ever considering a wealth tax. Whether it’s what the people want or not.

That’s not just bad public policy, it’s a betrayal of American democracy.

Sign if you agree: The wealthy must pay their fair share of taxes. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/wealth-tax-petition?contactdata=4/1w+WpKNCsTeHHK76lr/hmGT15X///uve1ka0Ow/0tYESpzbwA9y1H3ygBmNLl6NJWRup9Rg6Sw91J0AZuqQT7FtX8LjnAkehyhOYa1f4PX2Vm8yR3Kbq0L6R/SBukRFtfmFUqAqMtM/FznCTA13w==]

| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.

---
After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

Generosity from grassroots supporters like you is the reason I am able to fund my campaign and fight for America’s future. | | | | | Peter, I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support. Generosity from grassroots supporters like you is the reason I am able to fund my campaign and fight for America's future. Now, I want to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words. | | | | | | I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it. After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: " Don't complain. Do something about it." | | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️ It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor. | | When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy. When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, with AIPAC
preparing to spend $100 million in right-wing mega-donor funds and
recruiting credible primary challengers to our Squad of progressive
incumbents, our movement is facing an existential threat in 2024.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231205-2.09agqF&refcode=em20231205-32193&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1001&akid=32193%2E1203867%2Eo-zKkl ]Daily Beast headline: The Squad is facing an 'existential threat' in
2024

A new article by the Daily Beast points out the challenges we face and our
critical need for grassroots support if we’re going to not only expand our
bloc of progressives in Congress, but protect what we’ve built by
re-electing the Squad.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231205-2.09agqF&refcode=em20231205-32193&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1002&akid=32193%2E1203867%2Eo-zKkl ]The future of our movement and the Democratic Party is at stake: can
you rush $3 or more today to directly fuel our work to
protect incumbents like Cori Bush, Ilhan Omar, and Jamaal Bowman in their
primaries next spring and summer?

While Justice Democrats has long been the biggest supporter of these
young, working-class, Black and brown progressives, it’s no secret that
we’ve faced financial challenges this year, and we’re not alone.

As the Daily Beast notes, we face “a challenge virtually all liberal
grassroots organizations have this year: a massive drying-up of
contributions across the board.”

We already know Democratic Party leadership is going to be focused on
defending the White House in 2024, and they haven’t yet come out the gate
fully committed to defending the Squad like they did with more moderate
incumbents in previous years.

But here at Justice Democrats, we’re ALL-IN when it comes to protecting
the Squad against the multimillion-dollar attacks from Republican-funded
Super PACs like AIPAC.

The deck may be stacked against us, but we’ve defeated the odds before,
and we can do it again in 2024 as long as we have a groundswell of support
from people like you.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231205-2.09agqF&refcode=em20231205-32193&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1003&akid=32193%2E1203867%2Eo-zKkl ]Please, if you can, chip in any amount today to fund our fight to
re-elect the Squad and save our movement from this existential threat next
year →

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231205-2.09agqF&refcode=em20231205-32193&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1022&akid=32193%2E1203867%2Eo-zKkl ]Contribute $3

The only reason we were able to recruit and elect progressive champions
like AOC, Jamaal, and other Squad members over the last five years is
because of people like you. We need you now more than ever if we’re going
to save and strengthen our movement in 2024.

Thanks for all you do,

Geoff Simpson
Campaigns Director

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time.

There are other ways to make an impact in support of peace and equality in
Israel and Palestine: please urge your member of Congress to support a
ceasefire through [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139873?t=1023&akid=32193%2E1203867%2Eo-zKkl ]Adalah Justice Project’s petition or by calling them
using [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139874?t=1024&akid=32193%2E1203867%2Eo-zKkl ]Jewish Voice for Peace’s dialer here. Your voice matters in this
critical moment.

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20231205-32193-footer&t=1025&refcode2=32193_1203867_o-zKkl&akid=32193%2E1203867%2Eo-zKkl

This Colorado Gives Day, residents statewide are supporting the nonprofits that uplift our communities. [I humbly invite you to support Beautifully Broken and provide access to art therapy for women and girls healing from trauma in the Denver metro area.](https://wglgze.clicks.mlsend.com/te/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjcxOTg5NSxcImxcIjoxMDY3NjA4Nzg3NTMzMTgyNjMsXCJyXCI6MTA2NzYwODc5NzA1NDI1NTI5fSIsInMiOiJmMzZmMjY0YmNlZmVkMzdmIn0)
My name is Sandy, and eight years ago I founded my non-profit, [Beautifully Broken](https://wglgze.clicks.mlsend.com/te/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjcxOTg5NSxcImxcIjoxMDY3NjA4Nzg3NTg1NjExNDQsXCJyXCI6MTA2NzYwODc5NzA1NDI1NTI5fSIsInMiOiI3ODVkY2Q3NGJiODRjMWI4In0), to support women who have experienced trauma, through art therapy. In 2023, we hosted a record 300 healing group sessions at halfway houses and women’s shelters in the Denver Metro area.
By combining mindfulness practices with art, we offer therapeutic experiences where women who have experienced trauma, abuse, addiction, incarceration, and homelessness can safely unwind, create, and heal in the presence of a non-judgemental community that celebrates their wholeness.
One such woman is Chelsea. Her struggle with addiction threatened to take her daughter, her health...and her life. She had lost hope when she found Beautifully Broken.
|

“My life changed when I had contact with Sandy at Beautifully Broken. She stepped in and helped me in so many ways. My entire life has changed. I went from homeless to living in a sober living house, I work a full-time job and my daughter is back in my life. I love Beautifully Broken so much and am forever thankful - you saved my life.”
Sometimes, a crack in our foundation shatters us. Sometimes, being broken is an invitation to build ourselves back up, even more beautifully. Compassionate people like _you_ , who understand survival is an art form, can ensure women like Chelsea have the chance to heal.
[Please, will you help women like Chelsea heal this Colorado Gives Day?](https://wglgze.clicks.mlsend.com/te/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjcxOTg5NSxcImxcIjoxMDY3NjA4Nzg3NzExNDQwNTksXCJyXCI6MTA2NzYwODc5NzA1NDI1NTI5fSIsInMiOiJmNDkwMjQ2YmQ2MjFiMzYwIn0)

| Fellow Conservative,

A couple of months ago, _The Washington Post_ ran a hit piece on conservatives writing that small-dollar donors like you “ _**have made politics worse, not better**_.”

Small-dollar donors, they say, “ _**have bankrolled bomb-throwers who treat Congress like the Thunderdome**_.” they think so little of us, but of course, we already knew that. But to see them put it in a prominent opinion column is ... jarring.

It’s funny that they name conservatives in the article, like myself, but make no mention of some of my colleagues on the Left who are in Congress _**because**_ they were able to harness the power of small-dollar donors.

**Labeling conservatives as the enemy only inspires us to work harder toward our goals**.

**[Will you do me a favor and answer a short survey on why you donate to political campaigns today](http://links.teamjimjordan.com/u/click?_t=1b0bebbf1097419382210464ab5da85c&_m=3e3f2ba6655b4e7f97ecf2a4a86861c8&_e=Q0C88s6lnmMZM37KKakx9d8tIorqW63nBtLuhVvLM7k_tcLHLugMrX90vthrJSumpFCrOsWQ8u8GLKT1uLE-2GprCon0jr-bsDV9Nwc4-llpxdSvZ2WDFYzxS0vQJQsBraXuqW2fwhLy9q0mWk57ACw697TLkNd4pPa75OVMorPMn0od1A5b6JcO3D2XfMZDGw3ZsFkZ9aPeTsBteLCqmimuhH20CxFQAP7sv-HmgK4GC7mLjcBzhQdtclx9kX4MPP3QOXWvkmdHd-JszJDDFVN7qNjA2R5MX9KlJuYaw8_PnZ2gRPuCI5jxLH933uJh9FnSK2RUHC7LfmYdPWVuAf41ywHZ-LtBLaY0aho9d6jutSXIsXLogVVEjl9ZZ-HKcFtMl9VYibrKNJa6hjmMP9LEpPFlZo5SK_DxopWMa0eCJODBGz9jMKEIS63eX5pGDh2k-ZhlOnUs_vmWQhC7Xw%3D%3D)**?

[**WHY DO YOU DONATE
LET ME KNOW-> **](http://links.teamjimjordan.com/u/click?_t=1b0bebbf1097419382210464ab5da85c&_m=3e3f2ba6655b4e7f97ecf2a4a86861c8&_e=Q0C88s6lnmMZM37KKakx9d8tIorqW63nBtLuhVvLM7k_tcLHLugMrX90vthrJSumpFCrOsWQ8u8GLKT1uLE-2GprCon0jr-bsDV9Nwc4-llpxdSvZ2WDFYzxS0vQJQsBraXuqW2fwhLy9q0mWk57ACw697TLkNd4pPa75OVMorPMn0od1A5b6JcO3D2XfMZDGw3ZsFkZ9aPeTsBteLCqmimuhH20CxFQAP7sv-HmgK4GC7mLjcBzhQdtclx9kX4MPP3QOXWvkmdHd-JszJDDFVN7qNjA2R5MX9KlJuYaw8_PnZ2gRPuCI5jxLH933uJh_7VY-rUp-QIDMajMUhsuw-215wpgPAEeJtFZQQL3D3bfCwQSnuuEbn6PakBhA79OgAhD9a1ezpWwmEbEvYJfx9Mfn8afWVmp8NYIlpfExKvFkft1rQn0s7xRaq1t3xxBjm8jK-YMbbWg8h4-YaH1KA%3D%3D)
I must tell you, reading pieces like the one in question, pieces that are so out there, **would be laughable if it weren’t sad**. In another section of the article in which I’m personally mentioned, the Post went on to write, “ _**Many candidates – including Jim Jordan – have won over small donors by pandering to far-right causes and bracing former president Donald Trump’s lies that the 2020 election was stolen**_.”

**The Washington Post has never met a Democrat they don’t like!**
We’re the enemy,Fellow Conservative, and to the intelligentsia on the Left, we always will be.

**The Washington Post** thinks that conservatives like me “specialize in political stunts” on TV only to be rewarded by you and other steadfast supporters with political donations.

**They couldn’t be more wrong.**

body:
The U.S. government must show leadership and use all its influence to help end the assault on Gaza and work towards the release of more hostages and lasting peace in the region. | | | **Seven days, Peter.**

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | | This time, the new complaint was filed by a conservative group (hey, even a broken clock is right twice a day), and it alleges an "ongoing failure" to "fully complete" financial disclosure reports as required by lawmakers, while raising questions about Sinema’s personal assets and conflicts of interest. Arizona deserves so much better. That’s why we’re supporting Democrat Ruben Gallego, a former Marine who has integrity and will always put Arizonans first. Kyrsten Sinema long ago sold out her constituents for access to donors and living a high-end luxury lifestyle. Thanks for all your help in holding Sinema accountable, -Replace Sinema | | Sent via . | Peter,

As a current Member of Congress and a working mom of three, I’m a planner. Whether it be working to deliver for Virginians in Congress or doing laundry between events, I like to look ahead and be prepared for anything that comes my way.

body:
Tuberville stood down. Hundreds of officers will have their promotions approved.
#
Derek: Christmas came early this year.
[](https://act.votevets.org/go/12031?t=1&akid=21285%2E3013755%2EF9Qo7p)
Tuberville stood down. Hundreds of officers will have their promotions approved.
This was a long fight, and this outcome was not guaranteed. But together, we pressured Tuberville and the GOP for months to get out of the way and let these officers take their positions.
We mobilized Veterans:
[](https://act.votevets.org/go/12032?t=2&akid=21285%2E3013755%2EF9Qo7p)
We ran ads:
[](https://act.votevets.org/go/7263?t=3&akid=21285%2E3013755%2EF9Qo7p)
We took the fight to the steps of the Capitol:
[](https://act.votevets.org/go/12024?t=4&akid=21285%2E3013755%2EF9Qo7p)
We showed Tuberville and the GOP that politicizing our Military is a losing game, and that they would pay a deep price if this continued.
We did a good thing here, Derek. This is a good day. And we couldn’t have done it without you.
The work isn’t done — and we’re confident that Senate Democrats will do everything they can to get the rest of these officers through. We’ll be pushing with them every step of the way.
But for now, we have reason to celebrate.
Thank you,
The team at VoteVets

| Dear Friends and Neighbors,

When I was in college, I wanted to make my career in environmental protection. I went to Penn State for environmental resource management, took an internship at a wastewater treatment plant, and did graduate research on the relationship between environmental science and policy.

Along the way, I discovered that politics often trumped science in the issuance of environmental regulations. I learned that fearmongering was a favorite tactic of radical environmentalists. And I realized that some of my peers cared more about tearing down capitalism than protecting natural resources.

Unfortunately, that sentiment remains alive and well among the far left.

This week in the Middle East, world leaders are negotiating a new international treaty to combat global climate change. Vice President Kamala Harris has already pledged $3 billion in foreign aid to the Green Climate Fund, which will provide additional cash to countries like China for climate-related projects. She is backed by Joe Biden and Susan Wild, who calls climate change an “existential threat” to our country.

Let me be clear. We are not going to die from global climate change. But the policies being forced upon us to counter climate change are causing grave damage to our country. They are degrading our economy, enriching Chinese communists, harming working men and women, and putting us at risk of catastrophic infrastructure failure. To make matters worse, these policies are not even protecting the environment.

Consider the Biden Administration’s approach to electric power. To reduce carbon emissions, the U.S. will close 173 coal power plants, half of our current capacity, within the next seven years ([here](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=2c06c75b6e&e=1090c5c412)). Meanwhile, China is building two new coal power plants per week ([here](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=a17c8365f3&e=1090c5c412)) and is using that cheap electricity, along with state subsidies and slave labor ([here](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=51457e9fc9&e=1090c5c412)), to sell us renewable energy components that replace the domestic production we take offline.

That’s not protecting the environment. That’s raising our electricity costs and making us more dependent on China.

The U.S. has abundant, clean, domestic energy reserves that can deliver affordable power without relying on foreign sources, if only our government lets us use them. And we are already moving towards renewable fuels and clean transportation without the heavy-handed tactics of the Biden Administration. If we simply let the marketplace work, we will have an orderly transition.

I’m just as dedicated today to protecting the environment as I was in college. But I’m also committed to freedom and prosperity. We must not be afraid to confront radical environmentalism and defend our rights to responsibly consume natural resources to improve people’s lives.

**Keep America Free.**

_Kevin Dellicker is a husband and father who has lived in the Lehigh Valley for 40 years. He's the founder of a successful technology company and a 28-year veteran of the U.S. Armed Forces. Kevin's not running for Congress because he needs a job. He's running because he's got the experience, vision, and courage to defend our American way of life. _

Friend,
John Lee is just as committed as the rest of the House Republicans to solving this border crisis that has gripped communities across the country. Fellow American,

You might not know me very well – _probably because I have been heads down working for the past seven years in Congress._

So, in my own words, I want to give you a chance to hear what I stand for.

**To my core, I believe the most important things are God, family, and country.**

**_I believe that God is not done with America yet._**

**I believe we need to unite as a party and unite as a nation. The hour is late, and the crisis is great – but I am bullish about the future of America.**

I believe in the law – I’m a constitutional law attorney and I respect the law.

**I believe America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of the world – _but our days as the beacon of freedom for the world are numbered if we let the far-left force their anti-American agenda on the rest of us._**

[**Last November, the American people put their faith in House Republicans and gave us a majority. We’ve been charged with holding Democrats accountable for their failure to get our country out of the malaise of their own making. | | Peter,

My faith has always been a core part of my values and my work in the Senate. I'm guided and motivated by the Jewish principle of "Tikkun Olam," which means to repair the world and leave it in a better place than how we found it.

It’s why I ran for office, becoming the first former synagogue president and third Jewish woman ever elected to the U.S. Senate. And it’s why I'm proudly fighting to bring positive change to communities in Nevada and across the country. **But right now, I need your help.**

National Republicans are doing everything in their power to flip my seat red: **Mitch McConnell handpicked my opponent to run against me, and he's being propped up by a shady GOP billionaire. Now, polling shows me 2 points down in a race that experts say could decide Senate control.**

I'm relying on your immediate grassroots support to defend this seat so I can keep up the fight for our shared values. They’ve proposed a law that would FORCE employees to go by the pronouns assigned to them at birth – no matter how they identify. AND it would ban their employers from holding inclusivity trainings. **It’s fascism, served on the cruelest platter they could find.**

DeSantis and his GOP cronies have no limits when it comes to _eliminating_ our civil rights and liberties. But that doesn’t mean we can’t stop them ourselves.

**Our year-round youth organizing team has been working to defeat fascism by connecting with voters across the state. But the truth is, these efforts require _significant_ funding – and that’s only possible with grassroots support from people like you, Peter.** [**_I’m asking you to do your part in this fight. We need 370 supporters to step up today so we can hit our $10,000 youth mobilization goal. Will you chip in $27 to my campaign to turn out a record number of young voters in Florida and boot fascists from office? >>_**](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/00ZoynaIUFWkY02raNMhrw~~/AAPPAAA~/RgRnUjdsP0TaaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL21hZi1lbS1wZ2U_cmVmY29kZT0yMDIzMTIwNV9lbV9mcl9iMV9uZXdfbGF3c19lbl92MiZhbW91bnQ9MjcmY2RtYz0yWjh5VGhTbHVBZUVuM080akVXOUs5QW1hdmgmcmVmY29kZTI9Mlo4eVRoU2x1QWVFbjNPNGpFVzlLOUFtYXZoJnJlZmNvZGVjZG1jPTJaOHlUaFNsdUFlRW4zTzRqRVc5SzlBbWF2aCZyZWZjb2RlY2R2PUJXA3NwY0IKZWtssm9ltPlccFIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAGk~) Peter, I refuse to let DeSantis cause any more suffering here in Florida. And I refuse to let him hurt even _more_ people as President.

There’s two possible scenarios:

#1 \- We raise enough money to fund our youth mobilization program in Florida. We reach a record number of new voters and get thousands of young people to vote for progress and against fascism and bigotry.

With your help, we were able to...
· Host organizing actions with more than 3,400 volunteer shifts completed;
· Call more than 398,000 voters;
· Collect more than 2,200 voter registration forms;
· Host over 200 phone bank shifts; and
· Knock on nearly 6,000 doors!
We look forward to working alongside all of you next year!

Brian "The Sign Guy" Bobbitt
Fresno County Democratic Central Committee
Brian Bobbitt, known by most as "The Sign Guy," has lived in the Central Valley for his entire life. Hailing from one of the founding families of Fresno, Brian has deep roots and connections to rural California.
Born in Los Banos, and raised in the countryside between Fowler and Easton, Brian's family supported themselves proudly as Union construction workers.
Following in his families footsteps, Brian held a long career as a union electrician in the International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers. (IBEW).
Brian's first experience in helping to reach voters was in 1988 - volunteering to help elect Jim Costa to the State Assembly.
Brian's drive to promote social, political, and economic change continued throughout the years as he worked to empower grassroots movements to connect, organize, and spread their democratic messaging beyond local boundaries.
In 2016, after Donald Trump was elected, Brian became even more determined to create lasting, systemic change by influencing policies, institutions, and societal norms for his community and specifically for his grandson.
In 2017, Brian attended his first ever protest at Fresno Airport to stand against Donald Trump's travel ban. He continued in his effort to be part of the change by volunteering to help Democratic Congressional Candidate Andrew Janz, who was running to oust long-time Republican incumbent Devin Nunes.
At first, Brian didn't know how he could help to get Democrats in the Valley elected. However, after a conversation with Andrew about a sign delivery problem the campaign was experiencing, he knew how he could pitch in.
Brian began delivering yard signs to volunteers and voters across the Valley -- and by the end of the campaign, he had an entire sign delivery operation held within his garage.
Brian had delivered thousands of signs, and as a result, built connections with like-minded individuals, community groups, and organizations. As part of his effort, community members throughout the Central Valley began to recognize him as the "Sign Guy."
As the campaign ended, Brian knew that he wanted to continue his passion of being the "Sign Guy" for Democrats in the Valley. Over the last four years, Brian has been a super-volunteer in building the bench of better representation in Central California. From school board races, to President Biden's campaign in 2020, Brian has offered his services to bring yard signs and other materials to voters by utilizing his truck which he now refers to as the "Sign-Mobile."
Brian says that he's more excited than ever to continue reaching, educating, and mobilizing Democratic voters in Fresno -- and he's not stopping now. Most recently, Brian helped deliver the essential items bundled by CADEM volunteers at the November Organizing Action, and is ready to help in any way he can next year.
